_note: Western highlands 3 km run: one 3 km grid over the Sarawat escarpment and its plains from Jazan through Asir, Al-Baha, Taif and Makkah to the harrats north of Makkah (16.3-23.7 N, 38.8-43.9 E), inside a 9 km parent; 27 hours on its own runner, published to the model-data branch as d02. The 1 km nest over Jeddah-Makkah-Taif runs on a separate runner (domains.json, model-data-1km).
